title: Finiteness lifts along finite order thickenings
statement: Let $S\subseteq S'$ be a finite order thickening of schemes [def-sbc-first-order-thickening] (a closed subscheme whose quasi-coherent ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_{S'}$ satisfies $\mathcal I^{n+1}=0$ for some $n$), let $f':X'\to S'$ be a morphism of schemes and let $f:X=S\times_{S'}X'\to S$ be its base change [def-pc-base-change]. Then $f$ is finite if and only if $f'$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism].

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 09ZW (label lemma-thicken-property-morphisms-cartesian), part (8), with its proof
